description: Configure a named sensor on `agent`. A sensor runs a script and its output is the reading. `script` is "<script-file> [args...]": a bare filename in the agent's scripts/ folder (no paths - that folder is the only allowed location), with letters/digits-only arguments. On a Raspberry Pi a .py runs with the agent's Python and anything else with `sh`; on a Pico or ESP32 the .py file is exec'd in-process and its read(*args) or `result` is the reading. Pass remove=true to delete the sensor.
name: mcp_sensor_config
title: Configure a sensor
